drill-rule.claim: MOUSE on green 5x5 block removes it plus adjacent wall cells whose far side is water; opens 5-wide shaft. Clicks work anywhere on screen.

l3-collapse-rule.claim: L3: drilling LEFTMOST green blk (r31-35,c37-41) collapses band wall r30-36 c13-35 only if orange blk below-left (r37-41,c31-35) already drilled. Other drills open 1-col gaps. Drills never move diver.

l3-drill-collapse.claim: Drilling a block in a wall band removes the block AND all band wall cells connected to it laterally (up to world wall / other blocks): whole band section opens at once. Explains L3 step125 opening r30-36 c13-35.

l3-mech.claim: L3: orange blk drillable but leaves orange Xmk (5px quincunx) in shaft; green leaves clean water. Capsules not clickable. Diver rises own column until wall blocks (not to top of connected water).

l4-hazards.claim: L4: red drill kills if diver near (c14-18 death, c30-34 safe). S5 west pocket LEFTx5 kills; S5 east edge inert; capsule/water clicks no-op. S5 untested: pillar block r54-59 c36-42 click.

l4-route.claim: L4 chain: S1 RIGHTx3->S2(red@7-11) MOUSE(9,34)->S3; S3 MOUSE(36,21)+LEFTx5->S4; S4: drill greens(17,34)(5,15)(17,40)(17,46)(17,52), RIGHTx4 (diver c30-34), THEN MOUSE(41,21) safe -> S5(diver 37-41 c30-34, no blocks)
